name: A Special Kind of Leader
body:
Due to the unique nature of your leadership style, you have a better ability to attract and lead unique cohorts.

Prerequisites: Leadership, Legendary Leader, Leadership Score 10+

Benefits: You may add your Charisma Modifier to your level for purposes of determining whether or not you can acquire a special cohort (such as a dragon or other special cohort.) However, you do not add your Charisma to your leadership score when attempting to acquire a standard cohort.

Normal: Your level limits the level of the cohort you can attract.
